title: Underrun
tagline: Top-down shooter in a dark station. Reboot the systems, blast the drones.
blurb: You get dropped into a station that went dark and have to reboot every system while robot spiders and sentries hunt you down. It's three levels, quick and tense, with a moody pixel look I really like.
desc: Underrun, a top-down WebGL shooter by Dominic Szablewski. Reboot the station's systems while robots hunt you. Free in your browser.
author: Dominic Szablewski
controls: W A S D or arrows to move
tags: underrun shooter robots top-down pixel station webgl js13k phoboslab
extraCredit: The music runs on the Sonant-X synth, which is shared under the zlib license.
